result.topic_en: Calculations for the Riemann–Siegel style asymptotic evaluation of the zeta function on the critical line: the integral representation of $\Pi(s-1)\zeta(s)$, saddle-point location for $\int e^{-mx}x^{ti-1/2}/(e^x-1)\,dx$, and evaluation of the auxiliary integral $\int e^{\beta y+y^2/(4\pi i)}/(e^{\alpha+y}-1)\,dy$ with Fresnel-type integrals.

[-$\alpha+\frac{1}{2\pi}yi+\frac12\frac{e^y-1}{e^y+1}=0 \quad tg\,yi=i\frac{e^y-e^{-y}}{e^y+e^{-y}}$-]
[-$\alpha+\frac{1}{2\pi}yi-i\,tg\frac{yi}{2}=0 \quad \frac{yi}{2}=a+bi$-]
[-$\alpha+\frac1\pi(a+bi)-i\,tg(a+bi)=0 \quad tg(x+y)=\frac{tgx+tgy}{1-tgx\,tgy}$-]
[-$\alpha+\frac1\pi(a+bi)=i\frac{tga+tgbi}{1-tga\,tgbi}=i\frac{tga+tga(tgbi)^2+tgbi(1+tga^2)}{1-(tga)^2(tgbi)^2}$-]
[-$\frac{b}{\pi}=tga\frac{1+(tgbi)^2}{1-tga^2(tgbi)^2} \quad \frac{1}{1-tga^2tgbi^2}=cotg\,a\frac{b}{\pi}\cos bi^2$-]
[-$1-tga^2(tgbi)^2=\frac{tga}{b\cos(bi)^2}$-]
[-$(cota-\frac{1}{2b(\cos bi)^2})^2=\sqrt{\frac{1}{4b^2(\cos bi)^4}+(tgbi)^2}$-]
[-$cota\frac{2b(\cos bi)^2}{\pi}=1\pm\sqrt{1+\frac{b^2}{\pi\pi}(\sin 2bi)^2}$-]
[-$\alpha+\frac{a}{\pi}=i\frac{b}{\pi}\frac{\sin 2bi}{2}(cota+tga)$-]

$\mathfrak{a}=\int\frac{e^{\beta y+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}}{e^{\alpha+y}-1}\partial y$ $\quad$ analytisch [?] von $\alpha$ ... $<2\pi i$ [?]
$y=z+2\pi i$
$=\int\frac{e^{\beta z+\beta 2\pi i+\frac{z^2}{4\pi i}+z+\pi i}}{e^{\alpha+z}-1}\partial z+2\pi i\cdot e^{-\alpha\beta+\beta 2\pi i+\frac{\alpha^2}{4\pi i}-\alpha+\pi i}$
$\mathfrak{a}(e^{\alpha-\beta 2\pi i}+1)=-\int e^{\beta y+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}\partial y+2\pi i\,e^{-\alpha\beta+\frac{\alpha^2}{4\pi i}+\pi i}$
$=2\pi i\left(e^{-\beta\beta\pi i+\frac{\pi}{4}i}-e^{-\alpha\beta+\frac{\alpha^2}{4\pi i}}\right)$
$\frac{t}{(2m+1)\pi}-m-\frac12<\frac{(m+1)^2}{(m+\frac12)}-m-\frac12=\frac{3m+2}{2m+1}+\frac12$
$>\frac{mm}{m+\frac12}-m-\frac12=$ [-...-] $\frac{\cdots}{2m+1}$
$\int e^{\beta y+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}\partial y=e^{-\beta\beta\pi i-\frac{\pi}{4}i}\,2\pi$
$\int e^{+\frac{z^2}{4\pi i}}\partial z=2\sqrt\pi\,e^{-\frac{\pi}{4}i}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-vv}\partial v=2\pi\,e^{-\frac{\pi}{4}i}$
$\alpha=\beta 2\pi i,\ \mathfrak{a}=\pi i\,e^{-\beta\beta\pi i}(e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}-1)=\pi i\,e^{-\beta\beta\pi i}e^{\frac{\pi}{8}i}2\sin\frac{\pi}{8}i$
$\lambda=e^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}\log\alpha+\frac{\pi}{8}i}\,2\pi\sin\frac{\pi}{8}\cdot e^{-\frac{\alpha\alpha}{4\pi i}+mm\pi i}$
$\lambda=2\pi\sin\frac{\pi}{8}\,e^{(ti-\frac12)\frac12(\log(ti-\frac12)+\log(2\pi i)-1)+\frac{\pi}{8}i}(-1)^{m+1}$

$\frac{1}{2}(\log\Pi(s-1)+s\log 2\pi i)$ [?]
$(s-1)\log(s-1)-s+1+(s-1)\log 2\pi i+\frac{\pi}{4}i$
$(s-\frac12)\log(s-1)-s+1+\frac12\log 2\pi+s\log 2\pi i$
$-\frac12\log(s-1)-\frac12\log 2\pi-\log 2\pi i+\frac{\pi}{4}i=-\frac12\log t$

methods.what: Integral representation of Gamma times zeta split into finite Dirichlet sum plus remainder integral
Change of variable around saddle point with Taylor expansion of the exponent
Saddle point location and choice of m
Bounds on t relative to m
Functional equation for auxiliary integral via shift y=z+2πi and residue

Leading-term constant lambda of the asymptotic formula
